race.comment: POLAR EYES (7) finds the maiden win elusive but it certainly hasn't been without trying. Drawn kind and doesn't need to improve much off recent form to be breaking through this time. TORPEDOES (4) has been leaving himself with too much to do when turning for home recently but has hit the line hard. Has jumped out well three weeks between runs and gets Toeroek taking over. No reason it can't be his day this time. EXPEEARE (2) is a 4YO King's Legacy gelding on debut for the Mooney yard. He's come along nicely in his lead-up work and can play a major role in his first look. CLUX STAR (5) has finished thereabouts in most of her starts to date and should be hitting her straps now third-up. Not dismissing. MAHALER (6) has been well found by the market in her four starts. Was solid first-up and has more to offer. Inside pillar bodes well for her chances.
